basePrompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate ONE high-detail painterly realistic historical panorama for a Chinese history guessing game, landscape 2:1 equirectangular 360-degree image (ideally 2048x1024). Eye level horizon centered, scene landmarks and human activity distributed across horizontal middle band, sky above and ground below suitable for inward-facing sphere viewing. Rich legible architecture and period daily life, natural atmospheric light, cohesive illustrated realism. This is an artistic reconstruction. No text, titles, borders, watermarks, collage, split panels or modern objects. Scene:

scenes.yinxu: Yinxu, Anyang, China around 1200 BCE. Late Shang bronze foundry outside rammed-earth palace and timber thatched halls: artisans casting ritual bronze vessels with clay molds, ox carts, linen robes, an inscribed oracle bone on a workbench. No later Chinese tiled pagoda roofs.
scenes.qin-mausoleum: Near Xian China 210 BCE, Qin imperial mausoleum workshop: terracotta soldiers standing in rows while artisans model clay warriors and wooden carts deliver clay, timber scaffolds, earthen roofs and loess hills. Earthy pigment on a few soldiers, ancient Qin dress. Not the modern excavation hall.
scenes.dujiangyan: Dujiangyan Sichuan China around 250 BCE. Ancient irrigation diversion in a green mountain river: bamboo cages filled with stones on a low embankment, workers guiding water channels, bamboo rafts and simple wooden houses. Show divided water flow, no modern concrete dam.
scenes.longmen: Longmen near Luoyang China around 675 CE. Grand seated Buddha of Fengxian Temple newly carved in limestone cliff, stone sculptors and wooden scaffolding at cliff base, Yi river, Tang robes, rocky valley. Huge open cliff niche, not a wooden temple.
scenes.hangzhou-song: Hangzhou China around 1200 CE, Southern Song capital life beside West Lake. Willow lined causeway, wooden pleasure boats and lotus on lake, silk parasols, tea stall and elegant low grey tiled Song houses, distant pagoda and green hills. Misty morning. No modern towers.
scenes.quanzhou: Quanzhou China around 1300 CE, Yuan era maritime Silk Road port. Large wooden Chinese ocean junks with battened sails and Arab merchant dhows alongside stone quay, porters carrying ceramic jars and silk bales, Song Yuan timber warehouses and distant low green hills. Varied period merchant clothes.
scenes.suzhou-garden: Suzhou China around 1550 CE, Ming dynasty scholar garden. White walls, grey tiled open pavilion, lotus pond, zigzag bridge, perforated Taihu scholar rocks, bamboo grove, scholar painting beside inkstone and small porcelain teacups, visitors in Ming robes. Intimate eye-level scene.
scenes.lhasa-potala: Lhasa Tibet China around 1700 CE, early 18th century. Potala Palace red and white masses high on Marpo Ri dominating clear mountain valley, Tibetan pilgrims turning prayer wheels, yak caravan, low whitewashed flat roof houses and rough earth path. No modern roads or vehicles.
scenes.pingyao: Pingyao Shanxi China around 1850 CE, Qing era merchant street. Grey brick courtyard facades, exchange bank entrance, clerks with abacus and handwritten account books visible in open doorway, mule cart, merchants in Qing long robes, distant brick city tower. No legible signs, no modern electricity.
scenes.macau: Macao China around 1650 CE. Newly intact Church of St Paul with ornate stone facade and attached church body, broad rough stone approach, Portuguese and Chinese merchants, porters with porcelain baskets, low southern Chinese tiled houses, glimpse of harbor sailing ships. NOT present ruined facade, no modern paving.
scenes.athens: Athens Greece around 430 BCE. Acropolis with newly completed full Parthenon and subtle colored architectural details, citizens in classical Greek garments crossing limestone terrace, Athena votive sculptures, distant olive hills and small ancient city. No ruin columns, no modern Athens.
scenes.babylon: Babylon Mesopotamia around 575 BCE. Deep blue glazed brick Ishtar Gate with gold animal reliefs and crenellated walls, wide processional road, merchants and donkey carts, date palms, mudbrick houses under warm dusty sky. Neo-Babylonian dress, no modern buildings, no fantasy hanging gardens.
scenes.petra: Petra Nabataean kingdom around 100 CE. Rose sandstone Treasury facade carved fresh into canyon, camel caravan laden with incense, traders in regional linen and wool, rock steps and neighboring tomb facades, dramatic narrow sandstone canyon opening onto sandy square. No modern tourists.
scenes.kyoto-heian: Kyoto Japan around 1050 CE. Heian period aristocratic residence garden: raised wooden shinden halls with cypress bark roofs and vermilion railings, pond with small arched bridge, noblewoman in layered junihitoe beside open hall, ox drawn carriage on path, spring blossoms. No samurai armor, no later castle.
scenes.angkor: Angkor Cambodia around 1150 CE. Angkor Wat temple newly complete, five lotus bud towers, broad sandstone causeway and moat, Khmer workers carrying lotus offerings, palm trees and tropical vegetation, carved naga balustrades. Restrained authentic 12th century Khmer clothing.
scenes.venice: Venice Italy around 1500 CE. Grand Canal at a busy waterfront market, Renaissance palazzi with Gothic arcades, small gondolas and sail cargo boats, merchants carrying cloth, porters and baskets, stone quay, humid golden afternoon. No modern motorboats, no later bridges.
scenes.florence: Florence Italy around 1450 CE. Newly completed brick dome of Santa Maria del Fiore and marble bell tower dominating small Renaissance piazza, masons with stone blocks, wool merchants, handcarts, citizens in 15th century tunics. Cathedral front is UNFINISHED plain stone brick, not 19th century ornate facade.
scenes.istanbul: Constantinople Byzantine Empire around 550 CE. Hagia Sophia newly complete with huge central dome and semi domes, Byzantine courtyard and stone street with traders, clergy and citizens in late antique robes, distant harbor sails. Absolutely NO minarets, no Ottoman crescents, no modern buildings.
scenes.machu-picchu: Machu Picchu Andes Peru around 1450 CE. Inca settlement in active use, fitted stone walls and thatched gable roofs, agricultural terraces, people in Andean woven tunics carrying baskets, llamas, steep green Huayna Picchu peak rising behind mist. No modern tourists or railings.
scenes.new-york: New York harbor USA in 1886 CE. Newly dedicated Statue of Liberty with COPPER BROWN surface, people in 1880s coats and dresses at island waterfront, steam tugboats and sailing vessels, low distant Manhattan skyline, natural autumn daylight. No green patina, no skyscrapers, no modern cars.

reviewNotes.athens: 最终游戏设定调整为约公元前 400 年，避免把图中卫城建筑组合全部归于公元前 430 年。
reviewNotes.florence: 最终游戏设定调整为约 1475 年；图中的穹顶顶亭等建筑细节仍是艺术综合。
